business_overview.one_sentence: LEE KEE trades zinc, zinc alloy, nickel, aluminium, stainless steel and electroplating chemical products, and also provides metal testing, consultancy services and alloy production in Hong Kong and Mainland China.
business_overview.revenue_model: Sales of metal goods; technical consultancy and rental income are disclosed in other income.
business_notes: Revenue declined 22.9% to HK$1,699 million as sales tonnage fell 4.0% and metal prices were unfavourable.
The group has investment properties leased under operating leases, with HK$4.325 million rental income in FY2024.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year reported profit is not consistently positive. FY2024 and FY2023 operating cash inflow was mainly supported by inventory and receivable release rather than sustainable earnings, while FY2022 profit consumed cash through working capital.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company, Hong Kong operating subsidiaries, Mainland China subsidiaries and other overseas subsidiaries beyond currency denomination.
No explicit restricted cash line was found; management discussion describes cash and bank balances as unrestricted.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed.
The 2022 cash-flow data was extracted from the 2022/23 annual report comparative column rather than the current annual report.
